test_quantization_num_parameters: test that quantized model has the same number of parameters as the unquantized model
test_quantization_memory_footprint: test that quantized model memory footprint is reduced by the expected ratio
test_quantization_inference: test that a quantized model produces valid non-NaN output during inference
test_quantization_lora_inference: test that a quantized model works correctly with LoRA adapters during inference
test_quantization_serialization: test that a quantized model can be saved and loaded without producing NaN outputs
